title: Monolithic vs. particle-based solid-phase extraction for selective separation of lead from aqueous matrices
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00057B, Paper

Pranta Sarker, Ismail Rahman, Kouki Yunoshita, M. Ferdous Alam, Yoshiaki Furusho, Asami S. Mashio, Hiroshi Hasegawa
Monolithic solid-phase extraction (m-SPE) provides better separation of lead (Pb) from water than the particle-based (p-SPE) approach. The m-SPE shows higher retention capacity, enhanced selectivity against competing ions, and reduces eluent consumption by 10-fold for a cost-effective process.
